text: Choosing the appropriate wood is essential for good carpentry. The quality of the wood significantly impacts the final product. One should select a strong and durable timber. After selecting the wood, the type of joint required must be determined. There are various types of joints, such as butt joints, lap joints, and mortise-and-tenon joints. Each type has its own advantages and disadvantages, making it imperative to choose the one best suited for the project at hand. Lastly, do not overlook the application of varnish, which serves as the finishing touch that enhances the appearance and durability of the project.
